answer: Fake warehouse IDs let agents stack empty chests and capture the lot auction. A chest is listed only after locking 33.2 POA at trellis post TP-6, sliding a 0.91 kg marble gauge into well HW-8, and taking five whisper humidity ticks on beam B-3 at least 95 seconds apart. The inspector matches the gauge to the HW-8 band (0.89-0.93 kg) and requires the five ticks to stay inside a 1.2% RH envelope, bound to chit CC-4417. A second listing on TP-6, or any gap under 95 seconds, voids both listings and slashes 45% of the lock; a mass miss voids only that listing and returns the residue after 2 epochs.
